title: Make the CI system-package install survive a busy apt lock
description: Found by the TASK-9.1 judge (2026-11-19): CI run 44441353985 attempt 1 and main's run 44434902016 both failed at 'Install Playwright system dependencies' because the Ubuntu runner's dpkg lock was held by another apt-get (unattended upgrades at boot). apt exits 100 in seconds, so TASK-1.19's three retries (10 s apart) all hit the same lock. A re-run fixed both, but every push risks a false red.

nodes.title: Make the CI system-package install survive a busy apt lock
Bootstrap the strict TypeScript project with one-command checks
Run every check in GitHub Actions on each push and pull request
Retry the stalled Playwright system-dependency install in CI

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given another apt process holds the dpkg lock when the step starts, When the system-package install runs, Then it waits for the lock to clear (or uses apt's lock timeout) for up to a set limit before installing, instead of failing with exit 100
Given the lock never clears within the limit, When the step gives up, Then it fails with a clear ::error:: line naming the lock, within the step's existing timeout
Given the workflow test, When it checks the install step, Then it asserts the lock handling is present
